known_limitations: Trained on 1117 small drug-like molecules (ESOL/Delaney dataset); unreliable outside this applicability domain.

Scaffold split means test metrics reflect generalization to unseen scaffolds, not i.i.d. performance - a harder, more honest evaluation than a random split, but not directly comparable to papers using random splits on the same dataset.

Measurably worse on large hydrophobic/polyhalogenated compounds (PCBs, polyaromatic hydrocarbons, long-chain alkanes): MAE 0.90 on this 17-compound subset vs 0.40 dataset-wide - treat predictions for such molecules with reduced confidence.
